title: VTC: add /query methods for VTCRecording and VTCLivestream
description: Both VTCRecording and VTCLivestream are top-level JMAP types with get/changes/set but no /query. Without query you cannot search recordings by callId, date, or initiator. Add standard /query and /queryChanges for both, with filter properties including callId, state, startedAfter/startedBefore, and initiatedBy (for recordings).
close_reason: Added VTCRecording/query and VTCRecording/queryChanges with callId, state, initiatedBy, startedAfter/Before filters. Added VTCLivestream/query and VTCLivestream/queryChanges with callId, state, platform filters.
